definitions.explanation: A bodyweight exercise in which one supports the body face-down on the arms and toes, and repeatedly lowers and raises the torso by bending and straightening the elbows. A standard exercise in physical education, gym workouts, and military training.

examples.japanese: {腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せを{十回|じゅっかい}する。
{毎朝|まいあさ}{腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せを{五十回|ごじゅっかい}やっている。
examples.english: I do fifty push-ups every morning.

examples.japanese: {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}するために、{毎日|まいにち}{腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せと{腹筋|ふっきん}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: To make up for lack of exercise, I do push-ups and sit-ups every day.

notes:
Composed of {腕立|うでた}て (standing on one's arms) and {伏|ふ}せ (lying face down). Literally something like "lying face down while standing on one's arms." It is the standard dictionary word for a push-up and is used in school physical education, fitness instructions, and everyday conversation about exercise.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
The number of push-ups is counted with {回|かい}: {腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せを{十回|じゅっかい} (ten push-ups).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せをする: to do push-ups
- {腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せを{続|つづ}ける: to keep doing push-ups
- {腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せ{三十回|さんじゅっかい}: thirty push-ups
- {毎日|まいにち}{腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せをする: to do push-ups every day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {腹筋|ふっきん}: sit-ups, or the abdominal muscles themselves
- {背筋|はいきん}: back extensions, or the back muscles
- スクワット: squats
- {懸垂|けんすい}: pull-ups
